spells.name: Flame Dart
spells.text: Range: 10. Damage: 1d10. On crit: Smoldering.

spells.name: Heart’s Fire
spells.text: Range: 4. (1/round) Give an ally 1 action. Cast as a Reaction for 1 mana.

spells.name: Ignite
spells.text: Range: 10. Damage: 4d10 to a Smoldering target.

spells.name: Enchant Weapon
spells.text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 8. A weapon you choose inflicts Smoldering on crit and gains (1/turn) +KEY damage.

spells.name: Flame Barrier
spells.text:
Castable only while Defending.
Reach: 1, AoE. Damage: 10+KEY and Smoldering. Triggers whenever you are attacked this round.

spells.name: Pyroclasm
spells.text: Reach: 3, AoE. Damage: 2d20+10, half on DEX save (Smoldering creatures fail).

spells.name: Fiery Embrace
spells.text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 10, AoE. An ally gains the effects of Enchant Weapon. Enemies gain Smoldering, and effects that would end it, don’t.

spells.name: Living Inferno
spells.text: Gain the effects of Flame Barrier until your next turn. At the end of this turn and your next turn, cast Pyroclasm for free.

spells.name: Dragonform
spells.text:
Transform into a Huge dragon. Gain 3 actions, a flying Speed of 12, LVL Defense, 10×LVL temp HP, and:
• Tooth & Claw. 1 Action: (Reach 2) 1d20+LVL damage (ignoring Defense). Inflicts Smoldering.
• Immolating Breath. 2 Actions: (Cone 10, AoE) KEY d20 damage, half on DEX save (Smoldering targets fail).
Note. You can maintain this form for as long as the temp HP granted by this spell remain (max. 10 min). When it ends, you drop to 0 HP.

spells.name: Ice Lance
spells.text: Range: 12. Damage: 1d6 ice/piercing, Slowed.

spells.name: Snowblind
spells.text: Reach: 1. Damage: 1d6, Blind until the end of their next turn.

spells.name: Frost Shield
spells.text:
Castable only while Defending.
Gain 2×KEY temp HP until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.text: Range: 12. Damage: 3d6. ANY die can crit vs a Hampered target. On crit: +20 damage once (instead of rolling any additional dice).
spells.higherLevels: Increase a die roll by 1 and +5 damage on crit.

spells.name: Omenrime
spells.text:
Reach: 6. Roll 1d6; you may replace any single die rolled within Reach with that die (it expires at the end of the encounter if unused).
Replacing a die. Swap the die for your d6; treat it as if that die were the original roll.

spells.name: Rimeblades
spells.text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 12, AoE. Conjure icy blades in 5 contiguous spaces; this area is Difficult Terrain. Creatures there (or who enter later) suffer 2d6 damage for each space they touch.

spells.name: Arctic Blast
spells.text: Reach: Cone 4, AoE. Damage: 4d6+10. This area is Difficult Terrain for 1 round. Any already Hampered creatures there are Restrained (frozen in place).

spells.name: Glacier Strike
spells.text: Range: 12, 3×3 AoE. Damage: d66 bludgeoning. Creatures adjacent to that area take half as much. The entire area permanently becomes Difficult Terrain.

spells.name: Arctic Annihilation
spells.text:
Reach: 12, AoE. Any targets you choose are encased in ice and immune to damage and negative effects until the start of their next turn. All others take d66 damage, then make a STR save or be Incapacitated until the end of their next turn.
Note. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before using it again.

spells.name: Zap
spells.text: Range: 8. Damage: 1d8+4. On miss: you take half the damage instead.

spells.name: Overload
spells.text:
Castable only if Charged, ending the condition.
Reach: 2, AoE. Damage: 2d8.

spells.name: Arc Lightning
spells.text:
Range: 12. Damage: 3d8. Also hits the next closest creature.
Next Closest Creature. If you are the closest, you are hit! If 2 creatures are equally close, the GM can select randomly, the taller one, or whoever has the most metal.

spells.name: Alacrity
spells.text: (1/turn) Teleport up to your Speed, gain Charged (can be cast while Defending, after damage).

spells.name: Stormlash
spells.text: Line: 12, AoE. Damage: 3d8+4 and Prone on a failed STR save. Creatures with a large amount of metal (e.g., armor or a longsword) roll with disadvantage and suffer +10 damage.

spells.name: Electrickery
spells.text:
Castable when an ally is attacked.
Range: 8. Teleport an ally away. Teleport another creature there on a failed WIL save (making them the target). Costs 1 action if Charged, ending the condition.

spells.name: Electrocharge
spells.text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 4. Give a creature Charged, +1 max action, +5 Defense, 2× Speed, and advantage on DEX saves.

spells.name: Ride the Lightning
spells.text: Reach: 12, AoE. Teleport to a spot you can see (if a willing creature is there, swap places with them). Adjacent creatures take d88 damage and Knockback 2. Creatures moved 2+ spaces are also knocked Prone, Dazed, and deafened for 1 day.

spells.name: Seething Storm
spells.text:
Concentration: 1 min. Become a cloud of tempestuous storm. You can fly, move for free 1/round, and attacks against you are disadvantaged. At the end of each of your turns, strike up to 4 creatures within Reach 4 with a bolt of lightning for d88 damage (a creature can only be struck 1/round).
Costs 3 actions each round to maintain. +2 Reach and +2 lightning bolts each round.
Note. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before you can use it again.

spells.name: Razor Wind
spells.text: Range: 12. Damage: 2d4 slashing, with advantage OR include a 2nd creature adjacent to your target.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.text: Range: 6. Restore 1d4 HP to a Dying creature. If healed for 4+: they also regain 1 action.

spells.name: Blustery Gale
spells.text: Range: 12. Damage: 3d4 bludgeoning (advantage vs flying/Small/Tiny). Hit or miss, Knockback 2.

spells.name: Barrier of Wind
spells.text:
Castable only while Defending vs Ranged.
Reduce the Primary Die by 3. If it misses, redirect the original attack to another space within Reach 1.

spells.name: Echoburst
spells.text: Reach: 1. Damage: d44 bludgeoning (ignoring Defense). Any creature in the targeted space at the beginning of your next turn takes this damage again.

spells.name: Eye of the Storm
spells.text: Reach: 3, AoE. Damage: 4d4+10 bludgeoning to enemies. Place surviving creatures anywhere within 1 space of the storm’s Reach on a failed STR save.

spells.name: Updraft
spells.text: Reach: 12, 5×5 AoE. Damage: 20 bludgeoning minus a DEX save. On 10+ damage, they land Prone and Dazed.

spells.name: Thousand Cuts
spells.text: Range: 12. Damage: d44 slashing with advantage. Also damages enemies within Reach 1 of your target.

spells.name: Boisterous Winds

spells.name: Rebuke
spells.text: Reach: 4. Damage: 1d8 (ignoring Defense). 2× damage against undead or cowardly (those Frightened or behind Cover).

spells.name: True Strike

spells.name: Heal
spells.text:
Reach: 1. Heal a target 1d8+KEY HP.
Powerful Healing. If 5+ mana is spent, heal a negative condition as well (e.g., Blind, 1 Wound).

spells.name: Warding Bond
spells.text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 4. Make an ally your ward: they take 2 less damage from all sources. (1/round) When they are attacked, you may be attacked for some or all of the damage instead.

spells.name: Condemn
spells.text:
Reach: 4. Damage: 30 to a Guilty target, can’t be reduced by any means. The next attack against that enemy gains advantage.
Guilty. A creature who crits is Guilty until Condemned.

spells.name: Shield of Justice
spells.text:
Castable only while Defending.
Creatures who attack you are Blinded until the end of their next turn. Deal damage back to each (ignoring Defense) equal to damage they deal to you this round.

spells.name: Vengeance
spells.text: Reach: 1. Damage: 1d100 to a target that has caused any Wounds since your last turn.

spells.name: Sacrifice
spells.text:
Reach: 4. Reduce yourself to 0 HP and you can’t have more than 0 HP until you Safe Rest. Heal HP equal to your max HP, divided as you choose among any other creatures.
Dead? You may revive a creature that has died in the past minute if you give them at least 20 HP (also healing 2 Wounds from them), provided they have not been revived with this spell before.

spells.text:
(1/turn) Any friendly creature may use 1 of 3 charges to call upon higher powers for aid this encounter:

spells.name: Redeem

spells.name: Entice

spells.name: Withering Touch
spells.text: Reach: 1. Damage: 1d12. On damage, target is considered undead for 1 round.

spells.name: Shadow Trap
spells.text:
Reaction: When an enemy moves next to an ally within Reach 8.
Damage: 2d12. If Small/Tiny, the enemy is also Restrained until they escape.

spells.name: Dread Visage
spells.text:
Castable only while Defending.
Damage: 1d12 and Frighten all creatures attacking you in melee this round. Costs 2 mana less while Dying.

spells.name: Vampiric Greed
spells.text: Reach: 1, AoE. Damage: 4d12. Heal HP equal to the damage dealt then gain 1 Wound. Gain 1 additional Wound for each creature that survived this damage.

spells.name: Vigor Mortis
spells.text:
Castable only when an ally drops to 0 HP.
Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 8. Their max actions do not change, they skip STR saves to act, and taking damage while Dying causes 1 fewer Wound (min 1).

spells.name: Gangrenous Burst
spells.text: Reach: Up to 8, AoE. Damage: 3d20 (ignoring Defense) to damaged creatures, half on STR save (targets have disadvantage if Bloodied).

spells.name: Unspeakable Word
spells.text: Reach: 8. Damage: d66 with advantage (ignoring Defense). On a failed INT save (disadvantage if Bloodied or Frightened) the target is Weakened 10, and you are Empowered 10 on your next attack. On save, the opposite happens instead.

spells.name: Creeping Death
spells.text: Reach: 8, AoE. Damage: 4d20. If this kills the creature, repeat the damage to another creature within Reach 8 of it not yet damaged by this effect. Repeat until a target survives or no others are within Reach.

spells.name: Firebrand
spells.text: Touch a surface and secretly mark it with a symbol or brief message. Speaking a chosen command word while nearby reveals it.

spells.name: Fire Step
spells.text: Teleport to a fire source you can see.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.text: Conjure a minor visual illusion. OR: Ignite a small, unheld item within Reach 6.

spells.name: Chillcraft
spells.text:
Chill. Harmlessly freeze, thaw, or move a bath-sized amount of water near you. OR:
Craft. Conjure a sheet of opaque, mirror-like, or transparent ice the size of a window or door.

spells.name: Ice Disk
spells.text: Conjure a floating disk of ice that follows you. It can carry moderately heavy weight for 1 hour or until you cast this spell again.

spells.name: Wintry Scrying

spells.name: Spark Buddy
spells.text: Conjure a Tiny (squirrel-sized) helper for up to 1 hour. It can fetch Tiny objects, open unlocked doors, illuminate a small area, or deliver a harmless shock. If it takes damage or moves further than 6 spaces away from you, it dissipates into sparks.

spells.name: Spark Step
spells.text: Reach: 4. Teleport to a metal object.

spells.name: Tempest’s Command
spells.text: Dispel a minor magical effect, or temporarily suppress a stronger one (the more powerful an enchantment, the shorter the duration). OR: Your eyes glow and your voice is amplified to a thunder-like volume for 1 min.

spells.name: Wind Whisper

spells.name: Helpful Gust

spells.name: Light

spells.name: Beautify
spells.text: Clean stains or repair a small tear/break in a non-magical item, or conjure tiny beautiful things: flowers, butterflies, etc.

spells.name: Bond of Peace
spells.text:
Bond. Telepathically communicate simple thoughts or feelings with a friendly creature you can see. OR:
Peace. Imbue your spoken words with calming magic, granting advantage on any check made to soothe anger or fear in creatures who can hear you.

spells.name: Gravecraft

Gravemark. Magically soil a surface with blood, filth, or other disgusting things (1 Action).
Gravework. Shape/move a body-sized plot of earth (1 Minute).

spells.name: False Face
spells.text: Change your appearance to look like someone else for 10 min. Requires a piece of them.

spells.name: Thought Leech
spells.text: Reach: 6. Read the surface thoughts of a creature. They can sense you doing this and may not like it.

magicRules.name: Schools of Magic
magicRules.text: There are 6 core schools of magic. Each school has its own basic spells called cantrips and 9 Tiers of progressively more powerful spells that can be unlocked as heroes level up. Heroes can cast any spell from the schools that they know within the Tiers they have unlocked. Spells deal the damage type that matches the school (unless otherwise stated).

magicRules.name: Mana
magicRules.text: Powerful Tiered spells require mana—a portion of the spellcaster’s life force—to fuel them. A spell’s mana cost is equal to its Tier. Heroes gain mana as they level up. Cantrips cost no mana.

magicRules.name: Half on Save
magicRules.text: Creatures who save take half as much damage and suffer no other effects. Remember, a hero’s save DC is typically 10+KEY.

magicRules.name: Fire Spells
magicRules.text: Deal high, consistent damage at long range. Some fire spells can inflict Smoldering and gain additional destructive effects against Smoldering enemies.

magicRules.name: Ice Spells
magicRules.text: Deal medium damage at long range, with a focus on controlling the battlefield and protecting the spellcaster. Some ice spells have additional effects against Hampered targets.

magicRules.name: Lightning Spells
magicRules.text: Deal very high damage at medium range with a focus on teleporting around the battlefield and taking advantage of creatures equipped with metal. However, some lightning spells may fail to find ground and damage the spellcaster instead.

magicRules.name: Necrotic Spells
magicRules.text: Summon horrible minions or manipulate and trap targets. Some risky necrotic spells prey upon damaged creatures, sapping their very life force—but frequently fail to distinguish between friend and foe.

magicRules.name: Radiant Spells
magicRules.text: Can obliterate the unholy, the fearful, and those who would dare harm you or your allies. Equally effective at a distance or in melee. Other spells can protect, mend Wounds, and even restore creatures back to life!

magicRules.name: Wind Spells
magicRules.text: Aid in moving friend and foe alike around the battlefield. They can also slice and cut through entire groups of foes and viciously deal extra damage on critical hits.

magicRules.name: Secret Spells
magicRules.text: Some spells (or even entire spell schools) have been hidden or lost through the ages. Whether they are too dangerous or for other reasons, adventurers can sometimes stumble upon new spells (or wrench them out of the undead hands of a defeated Lich).

magicRules.name: Upcasting
magicRules.text: Each additional mana you spend on a Tiered spell makes it stronger (up to the Tier that you have unlocked). For example, a character that has Tier 3 spells unlocked can upcast a Tier 1 or 2 spell at Tier 3 by spending 3 mana.

magicRules.name: Range and Reach
magicRules.text: As with weapons, spells with “Range” can target from a distance, but have disadvantage if ANY enemy is adjacent to you. Add 1 die of disadvantage to gain +2 Range (max +6). Spells with “Reach” can’t do this, but work normally in melee.

magicRules.name: Smoldering
magicRules.text: This condition does nothing on its own, though some spells and abilities have additional effects against Smoldering creatures, ending the condition.

magicRules.name: Hampered
magicRules.text: A creature with actions or movement reduced (e.g., Dazed, Slowed, Grappled, Restrained, Prone, Difficult Terrain).

magicRules.name: D66
magicRules.text: Roll 2d6. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 4 and 5 deal 45 damage).

magicRules.name: Charged
magicRules.text: Whenever you take lightning damage, you are Charged for 1 minute (or until combat ends).

magicRules.name: D88
magicRules.text: Roll 2d8. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 4 and 5 deal 45 damage).

magicRules.name: D44
magicRules.text: Roll 2d4. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 3 and 2 deal 32 damage).

magicRules.name: D44 with Advantage
magicRules.text: Roll 3d4 and drop the lowest die. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 2, 3, and 4 deals 34 damage).

magicRules.name: D66 with Advantage
magicRules.text: Roll 3d6 and drop the lowest die. The leftmost die is the tens place, and the second is the ones (e.g., 2, 3, and 4 deals 34 damage).

magicRules.name: Utility Spells
magicRules.text: These spells are **not** learned like other cantrips; instead some classes can choose from among these additional spells as they level up.

magicRules.name: Cast Spell
magicRules.text: Casting a spell requires 1 free hand (or a held spellcasting focus), the ability to speak, and may require mana as well. A spell’s mana cost is equal to its spell Tier; cantrips cost no mana. **Upcasting Spells.** Some spells have a greater effect for each additional mana spent (see Magic on pg. 44 for more).

magicRules.name: Concentration
magicRules.text: Some activities require Concentration to maintain. A character can only Concentrate on one activity at a time. Whenever a character is **crit** while concentrating, they must make a **DC 10 STR save** or Concentration is broken and the activity fails. Concentration automatically ends (and cannot be begun) when a character is at 0 HP or is Incapacitated.

notes: Spell sidebars that define a general term (Smoldering, Hampered, Charged, D44, D66, D88, D44/D66 with advantage) are in magicRules, not in spell text. Sidebars specific to one spell (Omenrime 'Replacing a die', Arc Lightning 'Next Closest Creature', Heal 'Powerful Healing', Sacrifice 'Dead?', and the 'Note.' boxes on Dragonform, Arctic Annihilation, Seething Storm) are appended to that spell's text on their own line.

Spell text keeps the printed lead-in labels (Range:, Reach:, Damage:, Concentration:) and any 'Castable only…' / trigger line (on its own line before the body). The Upcast / High Levels footers are moved to higherLevels / cantripScaling with the label stripped.

aoe is 'AoE' when the card says only AoE, otherwise the shape printed (Cone 4, Line 12, 3×3, 5×5). Thousand Cuts is tagged 'TIER 6, AOE' with no AoE in its body; aoe set to 'AoE' from the tag. Seething Storm and Redeem likewise get aoe from the tier tag.
Arc Lightning's tier tag reads 'TIER 1, 1+ TARGET'; there is no field for that, so it is only recorded here.
Seething Storm (Tier 9) has a footer line with no 'Upcast:' label: 'Costs 3 actions each round to maintain. +2 Reach and +2 lightning bolts each round.' It is kept in text, not higherLevels.
Gravecraft (Necrotic utility cantrip) has no action tag on its header; its two options give their own costs (1 Action / 1 Minute), so actions is omitted.
Entice's header prints '(1/round)' after the name; it is moved to the start of the text per the brief's prefix rule.

Shadow Trap: header tag is '1 Action' with a 'Reaction: When an enemy moves next to an ally within Reach 8.' trigger line; range 'Reach 8' is taken from that trigger. Seething Storm's 'within Reach 4' is in running text and is not put in range.
Headline damage drops modifiers like 'with advantage' (Thousand Cuts d44, Unspeakable Word d66); see text.

There is no Concentration rule inside the Magic chapter itself; the Concentration paragraph (printed p8) and the Cast Spell action (printed p14) are included in magicRules from elsewhere in the Core book.
Fire has no Tier 6 or 8 spell; Ice no Tier 6/7; Lightning no Tier 7/8; Wind no Tier 8/9; Radiant no Tier 8; Necrotic no Tier 8/9. This matches the printed pages.
